objective: Add Tauri desktop auto-update: updater/process plugins, GitHub Actions tag release with signing, and a startup update banner (docs/r110-desktop-auto-update-spec.md)
acceptance_criteria: Step 1: spec section 4 Step 1 (1-1..1-5): updater/process plugins, tauri.conf.json pubkey and single endpoint, minimal capability, release workflow with version check and no secret echo, cargo check passes
Step 2: spec section 4 Step 2 (2-1..2-6): Tauri-only update banner and wrapper with Vitest, web never imports updater, semantic tokens, tsc/lint/vitest/next build pass
Step 3: spec section 4 Step 3 (3-1..3-2): static review of key/secret exposure, capability scope, endpoint and pubkey consistency, web bundle impact, then re-run checks and merge
